0048847056a9bce8b32b2360eb0368c182f41364.en: A stopwatch with two stamps. On the same 31 slots with account 82 the nine-position triple became an independent source of arrivals and the dial is only the five-position pair. The fixed word has 535 contacts: a reading, a step of the source back, a second reading, two steps of the source forward and a tick of the dial. The first reading watches for source phase 0, the second for phase 1. Per circuit of nine steps two arrivals come, and the gaps between them alternate 1, 8, 1, 8. The initial phase of the source decides which gap comes first. The dial stamps both arrivals and the interval is the difference of the stamps modulo 5. It comes out 1, or 3, and so the gap 1, or 8, is read exactly. At the same dial phase the first record is the same and the second differs. Ten preparations give ten different pairs of records, so for the first time the second record carries a datum the first does not. [candidate-C, complete enumeration, three implementations, two sessions] The new information comes from the variable gap. A coprime period would not suffice, because with a fixed gap L the second record is always the first shifted by L. [C; reading]

00f3b73856e6b4082d2fae3657530e6c13a4ce3e.en: A short past fixes the phase. Whoever sees the last 5 · 2ᵏ⁻¹ bits knows the phase modulo 2ᵏ, even without an absolute clock. For k = 3, 20 bits suffice and the phase is known modulo 8. [T, U-FINITE-HISTORY-CLOCK-PHASE]

02a7b420327419ca22a0e28e9ba51f6242880c1f.en: For θ = 144° J has angle 72° and length 2 · cos 72°. Since cos 72° = (√5 − 1)/4, we get 2 · cos 72° = 1/φ. So J = j · (1/φ): turn by a fifth of the circle and shorten by the golden ratio. [T, J-PROJECTIONS]

072993659a66efbb9a353024714d9e84ed77e349.en: The model. Take three slots with numbers a, b, c. One tick is F: first the contact of a with b, then the contact of b with c. The contact is the law from the section Energy, the order is given from outside. [model] The sum S = a + b + c is conserved, so is the account E = q(a) + q(b) + q(c) and the difference account M = q(a − b) + q(b − c) + q(a − c). On every account level there are only finitely many states and the step can be undone. Every orbit is therefore a closed circle. [candidate-T]

0eb2c76fb97dfe8c9f4ee5f95df8e335f1c38424.en: A light cone with no integer points. In physics light lies on the cone E² = p². For the numbers a + bφ this corresponds to the product of both views, the norm a² + ab − b² = 0. It vanishes only for a = b = 0. Otherwise the ratio a/b would have to be (−1 ± √5)/2, and that is not a fraction. [T, elementary, recomputed] If we read a + bφ as momenta, light has not a single integer point on the cone. This constrains only this carrier, not all possible realisations of light. That the photon is a dial and not a point of the cone is interpretation. [reading] The massive walker with m = 2 does not exceed the speed 1/√5; light in the Dirac step goes at speed 1. [candidate-T, small universe build]

1114494a4434783702f658c2bcf7c31c4760b195.en: What is missing. On 2 November the author decided three questions of interpretation: the phase of the instrument's own clock is an admissible input, retention at word boundaries suffices, and the contract suffices for three marks. He accepted the construction as a candidate for the positive closure of the O row in its exact scope. [interpretation of the contract, L1, author] For public closure one frozen common contract is missing, with one construction and one family of inputs, and the prescribed public probe: reservation, preregistration and verifier pinned before the run, a run on two architectures with identical output, and the merge. The stopwatch contract still lacks the capacity-bound theorem and the fingerprint of the binding word. [judgment] The reading word of the original mark holds on one orbit; on the whole shell it reads 2562 of 2895 states correctly. [O, RELATIVE-CONTACT-COMMON-APPARATUS-OPEN]

132957f0b546d137cd459791e9b042ac225f40e3.en: In the program the world is a closed integer plenum, a full stage with no void. That is a postulate, not a theorem.

145bf2dccff439c816b7f3c0188a80d1dcf3006b.en: The arrow of time. The step J can be exactly undone in integers, because N(J) = 1 and J has an integer inverse. [T] So the arrow does not sit in the irreversibility of the step. The working reading puts it in the length: (1/φ)ⁿ shrinks in one direction and never returns to any earlier value. [reading]

151fdcad25ede5f488c3ead96e504919ff9698cf.en: [candidate-T, note PR #1855; the author accepted an independent review with one correction of wording] Periods 13, 17 and 37 do not exist.

1a8ed8f752b39195739ad76bf34eb73b22c5daeb.en: The event does not carry the whole rhythm. In class III the deepest layer returns five times per circuit. Take w = 1 − j and v = 2 − j − j². The states X = (6w, 0, 0) and Y = (2w + 2v, 2w − 2v, 2w) have the same account 180, the same sum, the same difference account 360 and the same residues of all slots modulo (1 − j). They even have the same depth history: the floor every 5 ticks. They differ, say, in how the account is distributed among the slots, (180, 0, 0) against (140, 20, 20), and in the residues of the coefficients modulo 5. Yet X has period 5 and Y has period 25. Whoever sees only the events does not learn the whole period. [candidate-T, PR #1855]

1b7b8ef1fda18f770ebcb7e810f5b7ce9ad2b9bd.en: What the stopwatch teaches. The dial reads the interval only modulo its period, so the gaps 1 and 6 would coincide. The result therefore holds only for the prescribed pair of gaps 1 and 8. [C] A tick is not a contact: the same gaps last 804 and 4011 contacts, not 535 and 4280, because the two reading windows lie at different places in the word. The clock counts only whole ticks. [C] The mark does not sit in one slot but in the pair (g, h). Inside the active reading g passes through zero six more times while the pair is (0, 2), still switched on. Only (0, w) is switched off. My falsifier showed this: it predicted the opposite and fell. [C] The record is a phase, not a residue: all ten preparations and endings have the same residue vector modulo (1 − j). So the construction does not violate the fixed-word theorem and need not change the residues that the bank capacity theorem counts with. [C; reading] Three marks are the most that works. For source phase 0 the fourth mark writes into an already written pair and breaks the control. [C, exploration]

1e3fcc82e9e41f5cc7cb891dab2c21c2f3e15fb1.en: An honest coin costs a clock. A fixed reader with finite memory and no counter cannot manufacture independent coin tosses at all block lengths out of U. With access to the counter any sequence can be made. [T, U-FINITE-READER-INDEPENDENCE-OBSTRUCTION]

20adc0060aa3e5a94977a798767da14d3757b832.en: An event is a return to the floor of the orbit, and measurement needs the gate to decide differently. Both are proved in the model of three slots; a physical instrument is not yet made of it. [candidate-T, PR #1855]

217c23bc4e417e1bebafeaa74f07d2dbbcaaf072.en: A record costs readiness. The task: split a six from one slot into four threes, 6 → 3, 3, 3, 3. The lengths fit, because 6² = 4 · 3². The residues do not: the six has residue 1, the threes residue 3. The contact does not manufacture residues, so an auxiliary bank of four slots has to bring them. The cheapest such bank has account 27. With a sign, 6 → −3, 3, 3, 3, account 12 suffices. [T, RELATIVE-CONTACT-FOUR-SLOT-MINIMUM]

21b373b12da3f7a5ac2302813360d09597a91c8c.en: Which rule each thing comes from. The layers share one arithmetic, but their dynamical equivalence is not proved. Every result belongs to its layer:

2a9dfaa21a2731519647a6423320b904f67254d4.en: Time is the counting of steps. The world makes step after step and the counter n says how many have passed. Identifying n with physical time is dictionary, not a consequence of the machine. [D, TIME-CUT-READING]

3071e91913db2e28b71e67cd1aa1cacb09537c41.en: The number j is an arrow of length 1 at an angle of 72°, a fifth of the circle. Five such turns give the whole circle, hence j⁵ = 1. The arrows 1, j, j², j³, j⁴ point to the vertices of a regular pentagon. It is a dial with five positions.

30ec7e16f7b821fc8131acdeaab4155acd3019b5.en: Retention and repeated measurement. The author chose the exchange of a bank with an archive and the contract was frozen before the computation. The clock with period 45 occupies 5 slots with account 12, with two prepared memory sets of 10 slots each with account 28. Two measurements follow one another, each with an interval of up to 44 ticks, with an arbitrary pause between them. The first set stays as the archive and the second measurement gets a fresh one. On all 4 100 625 inputs both intervals are read exactly and the archive does not change during the second measurement. The clock ends exactly where it would have arrived without being read. [candidate-C, complete enumeration, two code paths] The account stays; only prepared memory is used up: every measurement consumes one fresh set. A used set cannot be used again and the five-position memory cannot be shared either. Two readings are two reflections and those give a shift, so a shared memory adds the intervals. [candidate-C] The final state of the 25 slots does not distinguish five inputs that differ only in how the five-position part of the time is split between the time before the first mark and the pause. They are distinguished by the length of the run, that is by the number of contacts. If all runs ended at the same time, the rest of the instrument would have to distinguish them, that is the source of marks or the controller. [candidate-C, two sessions; reading]

3189f40e6b186fb5ce577162ab2d06c3ab7c5e5d.en: The anchor. Integers have no units. To turn them into kilograms and metres, physics needs one measured number. Twist takes a single one: the mass of the electron. On it stands the equation layer of the bridge into the SI system, including the gravitational constant, whose numerical value is not yet claimed. [D, GRAVITY-BRIDGE-LAW] The anchor is not a debt of the program. Measurement needs it.

34d4cc8d0e93c5eef9ef45de75fc121def6d7b05.en: A small common contact instrument with a fixed schedule already stands on one orbit, see the section Event and measurement. That an external controller is necessary is not proved. A fixed sequence of contacts knows about its input, because the gates react to the input: the same sequence gives different histories of acceptance and refusal on (4, 0, 0) and (0, 4, 0). [C] The fixed-word theorem constrains only the residues modulo (1 − j): those the sequence rearranges the same way for every input. [T, RELATIVE-CONTACT-FIXED-WORD-RESIDUE-BOUNDARY]

34d68d516f561280595c198b6f60f3f0420d0bb2.en: Barrier and commutator. A bank can be closed by refusal. A contact goes through only between slots with the same residue on division by two, so an even slot refuses every memory. The pair (0, 2) changes by one contact into (1 − ρ, 1 + ρ) with account 8 and opens exactly the preparation phase of the bank. But the internal contact of the bank always goes through, so a write controlled by the barrier is a commutator: C01⁴ C12⁴ C01 C12. With the barrier closed its steps cancel one another. With it open the gate blocks one of them and one turn of the bank remains. So the write arises where order matters. [candidate-C, exhaustive search, two sessions; reading] Such a barrier protects the archive only at the end of the word; inside it turns. Without the internal contact of the bank, a write with a restored barrier on three slots does not exist. [candidate-T, two sessions]

3544ef3dad1c806e43cf43e05c5125e5b0c69aec.en:
- [T] theorem: proved, either directly from the axiom or in a precisely specified model.
- [D] dictionary: the Canon has agreed how to read a given piece of mathematics as physics. An agreement is not a proof.
- [C] computation: verified on finitely many cases.
- [H] hypothesis: a claim that a concrete measurement or computation can bring down.
- [O] open: we know exactly what has to be decided, and it is not decided.
- [candidate-T] and [candidate-C]: a proof, or a finite computation, outside the Canon, in the working project or in a draft PR. Only inclusion in the public Canon gives them a status, not a review and not agreeing computations.
- [reading]: an interpretation outside the Canon. It has at most the strength of a hypothesis.

38bba2c87c3a721137d2890a5cec8c9049f587ea.en: Depth. The number z₀ + z₁j + z₂j² + z₃j³ is even when all four coefficients are even. The gate of a contact asks whether the difference of neighbours is even. The depth d of a state says how many times both neighbour differences can be divided by two at once. Along an orbit the depth changes and its largest value decides.

3e0aa3b70a07f8755af93d14097e942a2ed17d88.en: The equation x⁵ = 1 is satisfied, besides one and j, by three more arrows: j², j³ and j⁴. Substitute them for j and you get four views of the same number. Mathematics calls them Galois embeddings. In those four views J has lengths 1/φ, φ, φ and 1/φ. Their product is 1, hence N(J) = 1. [T] In one view J shortens, in another it lengthens by the same ratio. That is exactly the shape of a Lorentz boost from the theory of relativity. [boost as reading: D, BOOST-COUNT-LADDER]

3ee33abd88303afe8d3ad2c7bca0df2e132456a8.en: The golden ratio φ = (1 + √5)/2 is the number for which φ² = φ + 1. Its reciprocal is 1/φ = φ − 1.

410b683f274513f4d94e9ea306866a27943f6f2c.en: Integers in, integers out. Length and angle are just two readings of the same step.

454517ca2caf69e1e8bd5fe95b23820e7f470858.en: Without mass (m = 0) the components do not mix and each flies in its direction at the same speed forever. That is light. Mass is exactly the mixing. [D, DIRAC-STEP]

4cbd5a673ce3d6a5afecb1821c3a1e16a7999d7a.en: It is half the sum of |z|² over all four views of z. For z ≠ 0 it is always positive. The smallest nonzero value is 2 and it is taken exactly by the numbers ±1, ±j, ±j², ±j³, ±j⁴. Those are the five vertices of the dial with both signs. [T, elementary, recomputed; formula from the proof of probe P-RELATIVE-CONTACT-FOUR-SLOT-MINIMUM-1]

4ead00fa37f2645d7506aa4d5c0ced5a922465b7.en: The difference of orders is the same at all five positions, exactly one fifth of the circle: ZXZ⁻¹X⁻¹ = j · I. [T, FORCE-WEYL-HOLONOMY] Reading this mismatch as the curvature of a force is dictionary. [D, FORCE-AS-CURVATURE]

4f7eaffff71f7fd08bbc33f4c6f613ed977f7184.en: An instrument from the same contact. On nine slots with account 46 stands a fixed sequence of contacts which, on the whole orbit (4, 0, 0), reads the mark and the phase of the clock and writes both into memory pairs. It returns the object and the clock exactly. The record survives 105 free ticks and the renewal of the banks erases it. [candidate-T, complete enumeration on 105 inputs, two sessions] The shortest clock reading has 19 contacts and two readings Δ ticks apart write 2Δ modulo 5. [candidate-T, exhaustive search] The clock with period 45 can be read too: the nine-position part by 49 contacts into two memory pairs, the full snapshot by 68 contacts. From two snapshots the interval up to 44 ticks is computed exactly, so the instrument distinguishes 21 from 41 as well. [candidate-T, complete enumeration of 2025 cases, two sessions] The mark is written by refusal: at the mark the memory contact does not go through and the memory stands still, elsewhere it turns by one step. The clock is read by resonance: the contact between clock and memory goes through only when the phases agree. [reading]

52c8e6f53c50b7ef7e2f0361ac5577a6a776c4a4.en: Inertia. A unit is a number that has an inverse in the integers. For the golden ratio φ · (φ − 1) = 1, so φ is a unit. All units among the numbers a + bφ are ±φⁿ, so there is none between 1 and φ. [T, number theory] On the ladder of boosts there is therefore no smaller step than one golden step. Reading this as inertia is interpretation. [reading] The walker inside one cell nevertheless moves smoothly. [candidate-T, small universe build]

54ea0aadc8fca5bf1243d83a4deef564e1921dbb.en: Mass needs two. The mass of one body alone cannot be read; it is read only from two bodies under a common law. [reading] In the small model two equal masses give only an exchange. The prime obstruction to reflection needs two different kinds of particle. [candidate-T, small universe build]

57b1ce052d2d23954021ba2abdd77e8ee81e2282.en: Take five positions 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 on a circle and two motions. The motion X shifts everything one position along. The motion Z leaves position k in place and turns its phase by jᵏ, by k fifths of the circle. First Z and then X gives jᵏ at position k + 1. First X and then Z gives jᵏ⁺¹ at the same position:

590aeeab48f317a2702791871a2852ebf48aab8a.en: Which of the five possible steps the world makes at tick n is governed by a single bit θₙ of the Thue-Morse sequence. It is easy to compute. Write n in binary and see whether it has an even (θ = 0) or an odd (θ = 1) number of ones:

5b8e0e137cb3a6def02e40a2db41356cc8ab39a6.en: A cell with a five. Take a digon, a face with two edges, and a triangle. Glue them along one edge. Among two-faced cells with faces of one to three edges, the pair (2, 3) is the only one whose modes return exactly after five steps. The mode k = 1 has the shape of J: the ratio of amplitudes, triangle to digon, is 1/φ and the angle is 72°. It comes with a right triangle with legs |1 − j| and φ and hypotenuse 2. You can check Pythagoras yourself: |1 − j|² = 3 − φ and (3 − φ) + φ² = 3 − φ + φ + 1 = 4. The smaller cell (1, 2) has order 10 and reads rotated copies of J. [probe P-DIGON-TRIANGLE-J-MODE-1 passed on two architectures; PR #1733 not merged, no registry row]

5dac738b35c0edf7a88164fdc5b6a244ff0393de.en: The step J does not change the rhythm. Multiply the whole state by J, by φ or by any number that is not even. The gates decide the same way and the orbit goes step by step the same, only multiplied. So the contact commutes with the step J. [candidate-T, elementary] Of all multiplications only multiplication by two changes the rhythm.

62994fcdf085e17980e25d8264f88819c9003398.en: A sixty-step clock inside J. You know counting modulo from the clock: 13 o'clock is 1 in the afternoon. The same works with the numbers a + bj + cj² + dj³. Modulo 2, J returns to the start after 15 steps. Modulo (1 − j), j behaves like 1, so J = 1 + j² behaves like 2. The powers of two modulo 5 go 2, 4, 3, 1 and return after 4 steps. Together J returns after the least common multiple of 15 and 4, after 60 steps. On the way it passes through a single cycle of all 60 classes that have an inverse. [T, algebra, recomputed] Inside the sixty hide smaller clocks of 3, 4 and 5 steps.

68037a6f826b6357bd1dbc3aabfd94b1460d0cba.en: The bank switch. The second session built an instrument on eight slots with account 23, in which the source of marks, the trigger and the bank selection are slots with accounts of their own and work under one fixed word of 40 contacts. The source is a five-position rotor (ρˢw, −ρˢw) with w = 1 + ρ. The mark is an agreement of residues: on division by two the source has the same residue as the selection slot 1 − ρ only in the phase s = 0, so the rule of contact acceptance itself recognises it. One contact C(w, 1 − ρ) = (1 + ρ², 1 − ρ²) moves the control slot into the memory family and opens the fresh selected bank. The commutator writes, four contacts close the access, and at the mark a short word switches the selection to the other bank. Within ten steps the first mark writes bank A and the second bank B, for every initial phase of the source. [candidate-C, complete enumeration, two sessions] The bank selection is therefore a physical state, as required by the occupancy, which cannot be read off the content of the bank. Limits: what is written is the occurrence of the mark, not the value of the clock; the archive turns inside the word; a third mark destroys both archives and derails the source and the selection. [C] The nine-position clock triple (0, 2, 0) opens the barrier by itself with one contact exactly in phase 0. The original mark (4, 0, 0) therefore cannot be used with one contact. [candidate-C and T, two sessions]

694cf26c740866204993108eadcce770d8668d7f.en:
| Layer | What it gives | What it does not establish |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Arithmetic of J | the integer step, the fifth-of-a-turn phase, golden scaling, the discrete ladder of boosts | that this boost changes measured space and time |
| The original rule U | an exactly analysed run and the limits of the steady dynamics | a lasting interaction derived from the run |
| Contact C and the chain F = C₂₃C₁₂ | conservation of accounts, gate switching, the classification of rhythms, limits of reading | a derivation of contact from U and a finished instrument |
| The Dirac step and small models | the mass shell, the ladder of energy and momentum, the walker's speed | that the same relations come out of the integer contact world |

6ad890bb42e2655ffe688ca343f148612b9abe05.en: But J needs neither cosines nor square roots. Every number z = a + bj + cj² + dj³ with integers a, b, c, d is a quadruple (a, b, c, d). The step "multiply by J" is a purely integer table. [T, arithmetic of the axiom]

6e6a2f86234aec6434f7d09724f0a253ab05a850.en: A complex number is an arrow in the plane. It has a length and an angle. You multiply two arrows by adding the angles and multiplying the lengths. You add them by laying them end to end.

71479d76560e71f5adf29457ac1d8618495c63ef.en: Light is angle without length, pure phase from the dial with five positions. After five steps it returns exactly to its place, and so it cannot remember how many circuits it has made. It does not age. [T for j⁵ = 1; not ageing is a reading] Periodicity by itself does not prove zero proper time.

7194b43050a626ccd6fc59c8587ba772a3b79889.en: Measurement needs switching. When two inputs pass through the same sequence of acceptances and refusals, one linear map acts on them, and it preserves the account. If the data return exactly, both records must come out the same. Distinguishing is possible only where the gate decides differently for the two inputs. [candidate-T, for an immediate and exactly reversible reading] An interaction that cannot switch a gate measures nothing. [reading]

72e5aca9238795c5a7f74b8e89d798b46f25a7a0.en: The Canon has a dictionary for this: length is gravity and scale, angle is electromagnetism and phase. [D, AXIOM-PROJECTION-DICTIONARY]

730c0770dc03997785ee4323d438967be6d216a1.en: In the program energy is so far an account, not a derived physical quantity. The account is exactly conserved at contact. The Canon does not, however, claim that it is the energy we measure. [T, RELATIVE-CONTACT-INTEGRAL-LAW; the identification with energy is outside the scope of the row]

74ae2ca5da4904c78a2d9512e2297827dcfc76dd.en: The contact does not move the midpoint s and the turn does not change the length of t. So the right-hand side does not change, and neither does the left. [T]

7aaca1a049e8ceb7dfcca99384e6a06c961bff06.en: Since 2 November PR #1855 is merged into main as a NON-CANONICAL note. The author accepted an independent review from another session, with its own code, but not blind, and the single correction of wording: the range of indices in equation (20). The statuses remain candidate-T and candidate-C. For a computational T the probe on two architectures is missing, and inclusion in the Canon is the author's decision.

7cba722f1bfce9e9dd9f800c1c738b1ad1b80763.en: Three dimensions. The Canon carries a three-dimensional lattice D3: points (x₁, x₂, x₃) with integer coordinates and even sum. It is the same lattice in which the atoms of copper sit, face-centred cubic. In the Canon it is a dictionary for the photon, not a theorem derived from J. [D, PHOTON-SPATIAL-TEMPORAL-TRANSFER] The reading that two spatial directions are phase directions (±i) and the third axis is frozen time remains a working one. [reading]

7e1c75d332e0a1d447b5d6db6123d4990cb542b3.en:
1. Close the O row publicly. On 31 slots with account 82 stand both the clock with a mark (a word of 264 contacts) and the stopwatch with variable arrivals (a word of 535 contacts). [candidate-C, two sessions] The author decided three questions of interpretation and accepted the construction as a candidate. The row needs one construction: choose one build and one family of inputs, freeze the common contract with all the fields of the row RELATIVE-CONTACT-COMMON-APPARATUS-OPEN and pass the public probe with a computation on two architectures. I recommend the stopwatch with the whole frozen family of ten inputs, because there the input distinguishes both uses. [judgment] Then read the mark on the whole shell E = 32, S = 4. The gate reads the difference modulo 2, the mark modulo 4, and the price of a record is set by the residue modulo (1 − j). The falsifier of every step: none in the finite class of sequences delimited in advance.
2. Coupling in the steady run. Three routes: let the letter c act on the sheet too, which changes U; repeated preparation, and then the question is what triggers it; or a contact between different objects supplied from outside. Each route is a different law. The step J does not change the rhythm of interaction. [candidate-T] Any route must therefore change the binary class of the state, that is its depth or its primitive shape, not just its scale. [reading] The decision is the author's.
3. Contact from U. Derive the contact step W from the original U, not the other way round. The rows MINIMAL-READ-DERIVATION and QUADRATIC-MEMORY-NATIVE-CONTACT already have exact conditions for both positive and negative closure.
4. A boost that also changes the reading. Find how the golden boost should act on the reading of time and space so that the same law gives the speed of the packet, the response to an impulse and a readable internal tick. Multiplying the state by J alone is not enough; it does not change the rhythm of contact. The falsifier of the proposed reading: on an even step n the laboratory period of the contact clock does not lengthen by exactly Lₙ/2.
5. The photon. Build the massless phase only after the action and the normalisation are frozen. The empty integer cone suggests that the candidate for masslessness should live in the phase, not in the length. [reading]

87e27f873e1c84ce5bb2e89767c72d1d69acf3ce.en: What the steady run lacks. After a short start-up the original rule U uses only the three letters b, d, e. Their order mismatch is always just a shift: the derived group is exactly 25 shifts. [T, FIRED-COMMUTATOR-NOGO] Spatial noncommutativity must therefore come from somewhere other than the steady run of U. [reading]

897e97338b54edf34c9745f8e14d1dea44b17b9a.en: The document rests on Public Canon v107 (tag canon-v107). The registry has 598 claims: 454 T, 59 D, 39 C, 2 H, 25 O and 19 F. Live H and O rows number 27. The results on the rhythm of contact are outside the Canon: in a NON-CANONICAL note on public main (PR #1855, merged 2 November 2026, main 0c33e2b2) and in the working project.

915494c8ec20cee8d05f9df204b754bc5a26b281.en: The falsifier of the document: any sentence in it stronger than the row it rests on.

9609b9b93f5480f479c6cacd307be3b0a7eeec25.en: One tick is a fifth of a turn, the angle 2π/5 = 72°. Five ticks close a full cycle. [T, METRO-TICK]

9b4091fe4f47d7fd084fe7bf29228d93d82fb321.en: Δp and Δq are the phase shifts of the pair and the triple. It works for all 45 · 41 = 1845 combinations of initial phase and interval. [candidate-T, complete enumeration] A reversible counter on 7 · 42 = 294 states measures the interval between two marks and holds the result for another 104 ticks at period 21 and 204 at period 41. Then it needs renewal. [candidate-T, complete enumeration]

9be26197173ca1162184a181e2a07c464f38e956.en: Twist-J builds physics out of one number J = 1 + j² and one step. It reads space as the place where order matters. It reads time as the number of steps. Energy as an account that is conserved at contact. Matter as the part of the step that does not come back. Interaction as a contact of two slots whose rhythm is governed by divisibility by two. The mathematics under these readings is largely proved. That it is the physics of our world is not yet proved.

a629e272ac16cb35a8f2ce2159e6e0e092c7cade.en: Interaction. An orbit interacts when some gate on it opens at one time and closes at another. Such orbits have period P = 4D + 5, where D is the number of ticks in which both contacts happen. The period is therefore at least 9 and never divides 10. [candidate-T]

An exact reading without a counter that turns such a block into a tick of the chain reaches no interacting orbit. b00d2ccebef4eff2107dd8b5c4af3d3a47ac12d7.en: Boost and clock. Read multiplication by J as a golden boost of the object. The rhythm of contact stays the same, and the account of the concentrated preparation (4, 0, 0) grows exactly as 16(Cₙ² − 2), with the square of the energy Cₙ from the section Matter below. [candidate-T, elementary; C for n ≤ 6] The contact clock thus behaves like the proper time of the object. [reading] Whoever keeps the original counter as laboratory time gets no time dilation. The Lorentz rate would be dτ/dt = 2/Cₙ = 1/cosh(n log φ). So the boost must also act on the reading of time and space; relabelling the state alone is not enough. [reading] In exact integers the period can only lengthen by a rational factor. γ = Cₙ/2 is rational exactly on an even step, where γ = Lₙ/2, that is 3/2, 7/2, 9 and so on. [candidate-T, elementary]

b42b926fa2045040704c1168a0135fded229554f.en: In integers this works exactly when x − y is divisible by two. Otherwise the contact does not happen and the pair stays as it is. This is called a refusal. That a refused pair stays unchanged is a choice of the model, not a theorem. Five contacts in a row bring everything back to the start, because ρ⁵ = 1. [T, RELATIVE-CONTACT-INTEGRAL-LAW]

b551aa413811b23844f2a73a46323d53caeb7102.en: Why not one? By the formula 2q = 5(a² + b² + c² + d²) − (a + b + c + d)². For q = 1 the square of the sum would have to leave remainder 3 on division by five. But squares leave only the remainders 0, 1 and 4. So there is nothing below two. Reading the two as a quantum of energy is interpretation. [reading]

b5ad0cfe15f43d0362307e068513675a6cd8d54c.en: The residue the contact does not see. Put j = 1 and count modulo 5: z gives the residue a + b + c + d mod 5. The contact changes x and y only by multiples of (1 − j), so the residue of each slot stays. The contact pours the account around, but it only moves residues about. [T, RELATIVE-CONTACT-INTEGRAL-LAW] A fixed sequence of contacts and swaps therefore only rearranges the residues, the same way for every input. [T, RELATIVE-CONTACT-FIXED-WORD-RESIDUE-BOUNDARY]

b6cd09e62bdb108c157225d5ccd4633d536bc68e.en: Space is the place where order matters. In ordinary arithmetic order does not matter: 2 · 3 = 3 · 2. For motions it does. Putting on shoes and then socks is not the same as the other way round. Mathematics calls the difference between two orders a commutator.

b865c2f55eff897159e3408284effff287f023c8.en: The photon in the Canon. The Canon has the photon lane as a construction on the accepted lattice D3. Every wave exp(i k · x) is an eigenwave of its time operator with a number s(k) between 0 and 16/9. Zero comes out exactly on the reciprocal lattice. [T, PHOTON-TEMPORAL-CHARACTERISTIC, conditional on D] The five-vector of the phase in the window is computed exactly. [T, PHOTON-WINDOW-COORDINATES] Whether the photon is really massless and what its full cone is remains open. [O, PHOTON-MASSLESS-PHASE; O, PHOTON-CONE-CONVERGENCE]

b8cda943b0f7e5d0466b149365ca04fe3ec2f005.en: The mass shell. For every momentum, that is for every z, we have exactly Ê² − p̂² = m². It is the same shape as E² − (pc)² = (mc²)² in the theory of relativity. The determinant of the step is 1 + m². For m = 2 it is 5, the prime of the program p = 5, for m = 0 it is 1. [T, DIRAC-STEP-THEOREMS] The Canon calls the coin m = 2 electronic and m = 0 photonic. Identifying them with the particles of our world is dictionary, not a theorem. [D, DIRAC-LADDER]

bbfd225ea9878fd60025f57f3a63099eecf0f932.en: The integer alternates: on an even step the energy is an integer, on an odd step the momentum. The mass m = 2 stays the same throughout. With the Dirac step this meets exactly. The walker's top speed is S₁/C₁ = 1/√5 and the edge of its band sits on the first golden rung when 5m²/4 = 1 + m². That holds exactly for m = 2, the coin the Canon calls electronic. [candidate-T, small universe build] Reading the numbers a + bφ as momentum space holds only inside one golden cell. [candidate-T, small universe build]

bc7e72b0366edf40b468da171c3d4ad8ad375ae4.en: The axiom reads J = 1 + j². Lay the arrow 1 and the arrow j², which points at an angle of 144°, end to end. The sum of two unit arrows lies exactly on the axis between them:

bf4bdab2c160f6ad808c20aed21f5e411196ee00.en: For N separated known inputs and N retained results the bank needs an account of at least 12N. As long as the result lasts, the bank does not return to its original state. Reversing the whole procedure returns the bank, but the result disappears. [T, RELATIVE-CONTACT-RETAINED-BANK-CAPACITY] So the conserved account is not consumed. What is consumed is readiness, an ordered supply of residues. Whoever wants a record pays in readiness. [reading]

c9d18ee67123002255622faae649b28d8ec50f5e.en: # The picture of physics according to TWIST-J, and what is still missing

ca823d0ca40d2b24a3c902d1843b57670a555603.en: Where to get contact in the original U? Nowhere in the steady run. The only coupling between coordinates in U is the shear in the letter c. From every state U reaches the steady sheet within 9 ticks at most, and c fires at most seven times, then never again. [candidate-T, census of the transient phase] In U, interaction is preparation, not a lasting process. [reading] The total energy of the plenum, zero say, does not figure in the registry as a claim.

cc119419b323ae26a336abc314a38144b39569b3.en: A clock with a mark and two records. The second session joined the switch to the clock: 31 slots, account 82, one fixed word of 264 contacts. The mark is phase 0 of the nine-position part of the clock. An AND gate opens the reading only when there is both a mark and a set selection. It is a commutator of two conditional contacts, and when one condition is missing it cancels. Into the selected fresh set the five-position phase of the clock is then written as a single one among five pairs. From the position p of that one the phase of the whole clock is read as K = 9p (mod 45), one of the five values 0, 9, 18, 27 and 36. The first mark writes set A, the second B and the third is skipped, for all 45 initial phases. [candidate-C, complete enumeration, three implementations, two sessions] It is a stroboscope: the nine-position part blinks, the five-position part is the dial. The flashes come every nine steps, and so the second record is always the first shifted by one position and carries nothing new. [C; reading] A fourth mark adds a second one into A and the code stops being unique. The control holds, though, until the 16th mark, when it runs into a full set. [C] A permanent fuse does not exist in a finite reversible instrument: every orbit returns once to the preparation and erases the records. [T]

cc2325bf81fb268402af875b4798b3bee329dd03.en: A clock from the same contact. The pair (1, −1) turns with period 5 and the triple (0, 2, 0) ticks with period 9. They do not touch, so together they tick with period 45 and account 12. An interval Δ of up to 41 ticks can be computed from two snapshots:

ce361005611d1ff36773a1ca832fb502de8b81f7.en: Mass sits in the length, not in the angle. It is the part of the step that does not return and carries scale. [D, DIRAC-STEP: the modulus of the coin is the rest rung]

d0d0e73b3761783ddc391d3e12c3b4a8aac6406c.en: Here P is the period of the orbit and R the number of refusals per period. [candidate-T, two independent proofs; C on 88 075 triples and on all pairs of neighbour differences with M ≤ 64] What looks like "nothing happened" on the coarse scale is a whole circuit one floor down. d0eda7a1ba56285cacdbd7bd82e7ba57f11dfaa9.en: Knowing and measuring are not the same. Whoever knows the shell in advance distinguishes all 63 classes of mark history after 42 samples. Whoever waits for two real marks waits, at period 41, until tick 81. [C, census of the shell]

d3956a52250e6c6c9c684a94961a9e690b64d374.en: The two readings of J are not symmetric. The angle returns after five steps, so it does not remember how many times it went round the circle. The length never returns: after n steps it is (1/φ)ⁿ and you can read n off it. Hence J⁵ = φ⁻⁵: five steps bring the angle back to the start and shorten the length five times by the golden ratio. The angle forgets, the length remembers. [T]

d58b925f47634f415b06f9d9a777075c3949174a.en: The physics of the program is not yet closed. We have exact arithmetic, a concrete contact dynamics and substantial parts of measurement. What is missing is one law from which motion, inertia and measured time come out together. The original rule U does not choose by itself: it gives neither contact in the steady run nor a law of the single event. The table shows all 27 live rows of Canon v107.

d6205a353b1519566b9f9e1b0205ad9cb844cd8f.en: Finite resolution suffices. With the sum S and the difference account M known, the state is fixed by the residues of its coefficients modulo m as soon as 3m² > M. On the shell E = 32, S = 4, m = 5 suffices. [candidate-T]

d626a57ff89f68c269f547a5f12b5fbd495edfdc.en: The Dirac step. A particle on a line has two components, one going right, the other left. The step S moves each component one place in its direction. The coin I + i m X mixes the two components:

e0f44afa9114114cf66f2cd9cd30264357e9fc6b.en: An event is the floor. On the shell E = 32 and S = 4 lie 2895 states. The mark "the whole account in one slot" lights on only three of them: (4, 0, 0), (0, 4, 0) and (0, 0, 4). Exactly: the mark lights exactly when both neighbour differences are divisible by four. [candidate-T] The gate reads the difference modulo 2, the mark modulo 4. (4, 0, 0) and (0, 0, 4) tick with period 21, (0, 4, 0) with period 41, each with one mark per circuit. [C, complete census of the shell] In general an event is a return into the deepest binary layer of the orbit. [reading]

e2d1d07d473dbc5e700d5f0f54b2e576ecd88601.en: Light is mass zero. In the Dirac step with m = 0 the components do not mix and the determinant is 1. [D, DIRAC-STEP; T, DIRAC-STEP-THEOREMS]

e40ea9bad73376e0daf44939d8f3ce1edc80cff7.en: The motion of a massive particle. The Fibonacci numbers F go 0, 1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8 and each is the sum of the two before it. The Lucas numbers L go by the same rule from 2, 1, that is 2, 1, 3, 4, 7, 11, 18. The powers of the golden ratio are assembled from them: φⁿ = (Lₙ + Fₙ√5)/2. A boost by n golden steps gives the pair Cₙ = φⁿ + φ⁻ⁿ and Sₙ = φⁿ − φ⁻ⁿ and always Cₙ² − Sₙ² = 4. [T, BOOST-READING-SPLIT] Reading Cₙ as energy and Sₙ as momentum is dictionary. [D, BOOST-COUNT-LADDER]

e4ca04a8c3448586845697783795b51d78fec413.en: A refusal is a pentagon one floor down. Double the whole state. A contact that was refused is now accepted. Its pair turns five times before it returns, and the neighbour refuses four times meanwhile. One tick with r refusals becomes 1 + 4r ticks:

e6dba1e34cfe1bdb8e2672cbe2ea7e0647836317.en: A record is paid in fives. The residue σ of every slot modulo (1 − j) does not change under contact, and 2q ≡ −σ² (mod 5). A slot prepared at zero keeps σ = 0. When it stops being zero, its account is therefore divisible by five, at least 5. A record in an apparatus made of zeros costs at least 5, with the sum of the data conserved at least 10. An apparatus with an account of its own needs at least 4. [candidate-T] Motion and event speak in twos; the price of a record is set by the five. [reading]

e7898517d2156f063c6d87f3b6b465c9c1ef0325.en: Energy as an angle. For a given contact step W there is a bounded generator H with exp(−iH) = W and its spectrum has two gaps. [T, CONTACT-W-SPECTRAL-READING] An eigenstate only turns in one step, and the angle of that turn is read as energy. [reading] But W is given from outside, not derived from U.

ef22fb6d4d702a9cff16bbcde47cf368e32c8268.en: Beware of the word model. Many theorems hold in a model that someone specified from outside. A theorem about the model is not yet a theorem about the world.

f1479901e71979471c4686580b0b01c1b2788f46.en: The account bounds the rhythm but does not determine it. (4, 0, 0) and (12, 0, 0) have the same period 21 and accounts 32 and 288. Away from complete agreement we always have 3P ≤ 2M − 5. [candidate-T] A long rhythm needs a large account; a short one can be had with an account as large as you like. The reading "the account is energy and the rhythm is frequency" therefore fails on this chain. [reading]

f299024f1a1707b1e71737ebb66c8be73e3d84a9.en: Without a clock the world is a mirror. Whoever reads only the six registers and has no counter sees, on the steady sheet, a law that is back at the start after two steps: V²D = D. Every law of odd order, say a cycle of three, collapses for them into standing still. [candidate-T, cathedral build 1]

f647f94774989a8361f5435b6630ade0d9607e72.en: Three slots in a row and two contacts give the first picture of interaction in time. Rhythm, event and measurement are all governed by one thing: how many times the difference of neighbours can be divided by two. [candidate-T, PR #1855 and the working project]
